goal: Make the qemu-sptm Windows Gate expose durable exact patch-application failure evidence without weakening git apply --check: capture the failing patch name and stderr in a CI-visible summary/log that survives failure. Use that evidence to repair only the proven patch applicability defect, then require full qemu-sptm Windows Gate PASS before exact E2E. Do not add TCG-store instrumentation or change address semantics before SPTM_MAP.
